items.author: DinoLeadingNews
items.context: Dino Vibes Daily: Adam Back dice que la solución para la custodia de Bitcoin es simple, "just cold-store it"; Blockstream se asocia con Thales para lanzar un sistema de custodia offline, citando el hackeo de $6.300M de Binance. Pregunta si el almacenamiento en frío es la respuesta definitiva.
items.suggested_text: Cold storage removes the exchange risk, but it moves the question to who built the device and whether you can verify it yourself. An offline setup you assemble and audit on your own takes that last dependency out. I wrote a short book on how to do it: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HQ5NS31N?dplnkId=c09ef739-11f3-4c76-8c62-92ce160a3341&nodl=1

items.author: thisisksa
items.context: Karan Singh Arora: $BTC marca 6 velas semanales rojas seguidas por segunda vez en 2026; la vez anterior (ene-feb) subió 32% poco después, y antes de 2026 solo había pasado una vez, en 2022, cerca del suelo del ciclo. Pregunta si la historia se repetirá (con gráfico).
items.suggested_text: Rare streaks are worth noting, but a pattern seen twice in recent years is a small sample to lean on. For $BTC I find it more useful to check where price sits versus its long-term trend than to count red candles. What would make you doubt the bounce this time?

items.author: JackStr42679640
items.context: Jack Straw: el ETF $IBIT de BlackRock acumula más de $2.000M en salidas en noviembre, 11 sesiones seguidas sin entradas; las redenciones obligan al fondo a vender BTC. Pregunta si se está quebrando la convicción institucional o es una sacudida antes del próximo movimiento.
items.suggested_text: ETF redemptions are forced selling by design: the fund has to sell when holders of the wrapper want out. People holding spot $BTC with their own keys don't go through that pipe. I'd watch whether outflows slow while price holds, more than the size of the streak. Shakeout or real capitulation for you?
